pages.title: About Us
pages.page_body:
FlowDesk brings tasks, docs and chat into one beautiful app so your team ships faster with fewer meetings.

Our story

FlowDesk started with a simple idea: the all-in-one workspace for fast teams. Today a passionate team carries that promise forward every day.

What we believe

  • People first
  • Quality without shortcuts
  • Honest, transparent communication

pages.title: Privacy Policy
pages.page_body:
FlowDesk respects your privacy. We collect only the information you share with us through our forms, use it only to respond to you, and never sell it.

Contact us anytime to view or delete your data.

pages.title: Terms of Use
pages.page_body: By using the FlowDesk website you agree to use it lawfully. Content is for general information and may change without notice.
